theatre.caveat: This month's window (22 Dec 2026 to 18 Jan 2027) takes in Christmas and New Year, so it reads higher than a January-February window would. pint.label: Pint of lager
pint.reason: No operator in the planned sample publishes draught prices on a page curl can read: Nicholson's and Fuller's return 403; Wetherspoon prices live only in its ordering app; Greene King and Young's pub pages list drinks without prices; Sam Smith's publishes none. Third-party pint trackers exist but are not primary.

flatWhite.label: Flat white
flatWhite.reason: Pret, Costa, Caffè Nero and Starbucks publish no prices on their UK menus; the independents tried publish none either, or return 403.

mealDeal.label: Meal deal
mealDeal.reason: Tesco and Sainsbury's return 403; Boots and Co-op serve a bot-check page.

hotel.label: Hotel night
hotel.reason: No free, repeatable primary source. Rates are only quoted per date inside booking engines; the existing samples in data/hotel-rate-samples came from a paid Apify run.
